purpose: Compare two-stage PPLX with two-stage Jina when Jina receives the exact recoverable R3 PPLX per-window strings.

population.pplx_failure_rule: A PPLX source failure is a D1 failure; no Jina calls are made for that request.

inputs.source_recovery: R3 stage hashes were matched exactly using frozen BRIGHT content, stored final caps, and stage-1-survivor carry-forward for stage 2.

jina_v3_5.native_interface: local Jina v3.5 rerank adapter; one score per candidate text; stable score-descending then input-order tie break

pplx_source.native_interface: authenticated frozen R3 two-stage outputs; no PPLX calls in D1

selection.stage_1: Jina scores each ten-candidate PPLX stage-1 window and retains its own five highest-scoring canonical IDs.
selection.stage_2: If the Jina ten-ID survivor set equals the PPLX stage-2 set, use the PPLX stage-2 strings. Otherwise, use each Jina survivor's exact PPLX stage-1 string.
selection.failure_rule: Any failed Jina stage fails the request; failures score zero offline.

metrics.sign_flip: exact 2^12 sign flip over paired query-level differences
holm_family: same contrast averaged over six shuffled orders
metrics.gold_join: offline after raw outputs are frozen and hashed

execution.gpu: shared GPU selected from pre-call availability; device identity excluded from exports
